title: Assemble the Story 1.7 spike evidence bundle, per-profile recommendations and threshold rule
summary: Evidence assembly and analysis over 27 retained benchmark cell results (JSON) plus scaffolding and runner: a per-cell CSV, a grounded analysis of pass rates, payload-vs-window and failure classes, per-profile recommendations applied mechanically from the declared rule, a machine-readable threshold rule, a bundle index, and the story record. No production code, no prohibition recorded. Requires reading roughly sixty small JSON and log files and synthesising honestly; numbers must come only from the data.
